cases.counterfactual_program:
(rule!
  (let* ([closed ((lambda (g) (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g))) (let* ((div-row (find-first (lambda (r) (for/and ([c (range 0 w)]) (= (at g r c) 8))) (range 0 h)))
         (div-col (find-first (lambda (c) (for/and ([r (range 0 h)]) (= (at g r c) 8))) (range 0 w))))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([p (find-color g 7)])
      (let* ((r (first p)) (c (second p))
             (nr (if div-col r (- (* 2 div-row) r)))
             (nc (if div-col (- (* 2 div-col) c) c)))
        (if (in-bounds? nr nc h w) (set-cell out nr nc 7) out)))))) g)]
         [parts (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 7)) (objects g 0))]
         [largest (if (empty? parts) 0 (apply max (map obj-size parts)))]
         [dr (find-first (lambda (r) (for/and ([c (range 0 w)]) (= (at g r c) 8))) (range 0 h))]
         [dc (find-first (lambda (c) (for/and ([r (range 0 h)]) (= (at g r c) 8))) (range 0 w))])
    (for/fold ([out closed]) ([o parts] #:when (= (obj-size o) largest))
      (for/fold ([painted out]) ([p (obj-cells o)])
        (let* ([r (first p)] [c (second p)]
               [nr (if dc r (- (* 2 dr) r))]
               [nc (if dc (- (* 2 dc) c) c)]
               [marked (set-cell painted r c 2)])
          (if (in-bounds? nr nc h w) (set-cell marked nr nc 2) marked))))))

intermediate: The completed grid and its four-connected color-7 component cell sets and sizes.
step_a: Complete mirror closure of every original color-7 cell across the unique full color-8 divider, overwriting in-bounds targets and retaining clipped sources.
step_b: Select the global maximum completed-component size and recolor every color-7 component of that size to color 2.
why_b_depends_on_a: Reflected cells join fragments within each half and change the component ranking: this input has an original largest component of size 5, while closure creates two size-11 components. Selecting components from the original grid instead paints the size-5 objects and changes the final answer.
